scope: Full16-body timer source port, including both compiled backend branches. Source review only.

mechanical.public_argument_names_and_order: pass:5public names/argument lists in Native order

manual_review.public_lifecycle: Disabled guards, lazy initialize, reset/discard/reinit and initialized-state writes match Native branch and call order.
manual_review.cpu_stop_failures: Timestamp then name lookup, blank/unknown checks before empty-stack/nesting checks. Exceptions preserve state up to the failure boundary.
manual_review.registry_and_stack: Native1-based IDs/counts; vector sizes are allocated slots.16/32-slot growth copies all old slots; reset releases both allocations. Recursive same-name regions allowed.
manual_review.arithmetic: Start timestamp before lookup/capacity; stop timestamp before lookup/checks; elapsed, inclusive/exclusive and parent-child operations retain Native order. Summary loops preserve insertion order, average/percent conditions and formulas.
manual_review.summary: Native header/footer strings and6columns, A48 name+I10count+F14.6times+F10.2percent, truncation/padding, empty-registry output and overflow stars retained. Classic decimal locale is explicit. Timing values are nondeterministic and not claimed byte-identical.
manual_review.paths_and_names: Only trailing ASCII blanks trimmed. No normalization. Native1024-character assignment/truncation preserved; relative paths use PWD only when the full environment value fits1024 and has nonblank content.
manual_review.gptl: Actual GPTL8.1.1 C declarations/constants and Fortran wrappers read; direct C calls map exactly. Only initialize status is checked, preserving Native.
manual_review.errors: Native-prefix runtime_error is consumed by standalone existing std::exception catch; no new registry/fallback. Explicit opening failure retains its Native diagnostic. After successful open, failbit/badbit exceptions map Native fatal WRITE/CLOSE failures into that same existing catch before state reset.
manual_review.comments_and_format: Descriptions immediately below all16 definitions; public header purpose/usage/state/output notes and Native helper order/dividers preserved. Call groups and units documented.
manual_review.state_exception: User-authorized private per-thread timing bookkeeping only; no public state, Kokkos dependency, GPU fences or science changes.

language_adaptations: std::clock/CLOCKS_PER_SEC supplies process CPU time in real_t, matching CPU_TIME timing basis; unavailable clock maps to Native negative-unavailable sentinel -1second. Epoch/resolution/vendor timings can differ.
std::vector allocation-slot arrays replace allocatables; growth constants/logical counts are unchanged. Forward declarations enable Native definition order.

Private ostream/local ofstream replace Native integer file units; local formatting lambdas implement fixed-width numeric fields and overflow stars. Standard C++ fixed formatting is used; no exact elapsed-field rounding equality is claimed.
std::string omits unused fixed-length path padding while preserving truncation before trailing-space trim. GPTL uses trimmed null-terminated C strings.
Fatal errors propagate as std::runtime_error through the established C++ standalone handler instead of Fortran ERROR STOP.

validation.builds: not run by owner; Root owns
validation.model_comparisons: not run by owner; Root owns
validation.utility_execution: not run by owner; schema inspected against parse_timer_text
validation.independent_review: driver_microphysics read full Native and reviewed lifecycle/GPTL/path/error boundaries; exact stable hashes recorded in handoff

limits: No GPU performance, synchronization or numerical-cause work.
All compilation/GPTL/runtime/utility evidence must come from Root integration.
